# Pult capacity

<!-- Generated by `pnpm pult-capacity` (tools/pult-plan/src/capacity.ts). Do not edit by hand; `pnpm verify` fails when this file is stale. -->

How many controls fit one pult screen before the pult splits the page into another screen (ADR-006: the pult never scrolls vertically). Every number comes from the pult's own `layoutPage`, `naturalHeightFor` and `panelMinHeight` (`packages/ui/src/pult/layout.ts`) and the token sizes (`packages/tokens/tokens.json`), with controls placed the way `pnpm pult-draft` places them. Use `pnpm pult-plan --contract <path>` to see the split for a real installation.

## Reference devices

| Form factor | Device | Pult body (pt) | Gap | Padding (x / top / bottom) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| phone | iPhone 16 Pro, portrait (402 × 874 pt screen) | 402 × 596 | 18 | 16 / 12 / 12 |
| tablet | iPad Pro 13", landscape (1376 × 1032 pt screen) | 1210 × 603 | 16 | 20 / 10 / 10 |

The pult body is the area under the pult header (Figma: phone _Pult_ frame, tablet _Console_ frame).

## Draft grid

| Shape | Controls | Phone cell (cols × rows) | Tablet cell (cols × rows) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| half | toggle, button, hold to confirm, knob | 6 × 2 (two per row) | 2 × 2 (six per row) |
| full | horizontal fader, segmented, label | 12 × 2 | 4 × 2 (three per row) |
| stretch | XY pad, colour picker, list (sceneList), button grid, prompt, vertical fader | 12 × 6 | 4 × 6 |

Stretchable controls get at least 40 pt per grid row (`MIN_ROW`) before a split, then share the free height.

| Control | Height (pt) | Phone | Tablet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fader (horizontal) | 82 | 5 | 18 |

| Knob (compact) | 138 | 6 | 18 |
| Toggle switch | 46 | 18 | 54 |
| Pad, regular (toggle / button) | 88 | 10 | 30 |
| Pad, compact | 64 | 14 | 42 |
| Hold to confirm | 88 | 10 | 30 |
| Segmented (with label) | 78 | 6 | 18 |
| XY pad / colour picker / list (stretch) | stretches | 1 | 3 |

## Typical mixes (blocks per screen)

| Block | Phone | Tablet |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 faders + 2 toggle switches (a tuning block) | 2 | 6 |
| 1 segmented + 2 pads + 1 fader (a live block) | 1 | 5 |
| 1 XY pad + 2 faders | 1 | 1 |

## Split rule

- Controls are packed from the top at their Figma heights with the form factor's gap; stretchable controls share what is left (tablet: the last item of every column stretches to the bottom).
- Controls that share grid rows form a band. A band that does not fit under the previous ones starts a new screen; a band is never cut. A single band taller than a screen is scaled down.
- `pult-draft` and `pult-plan` add one rule on top: a contract group is never split across screens unless the group alone is bigger than a screen (then it splits where `layoutPage` splits it). `live` parameters come first, then `tune`; `setup` goes to a separate Setup pult; `hidden` is left out.
